Woman Filmed Reel in Collector's Meeting Room; Administration Investigates

A video of a young woman filming a reel to film music in the meeting room of the Rewa Collectorate has gone viral. The administration has stated that such behavior is unacceptable and has launched an investigation into how she gained entry without permission.
